summary: Iter19 @-mention feature validated end-to-end. Backend endpoint GET /api/users/by-name/{display_name} passes all 11 pytest cases (underscore/space variants, case-insensitive, 404 on unknown, 401 unauth, response shape, plus regression on login/feed/discover/log-round/achievements). Frontend web preview: @Sam_Rivera chip renders in brand-green rgb(21,128,61)/fontWeight 700 on RoundCard notes AND in comments on post detail; tapping either chip navigates to /user/{sam-id} and Sam's profile loads with rounds/wishlist. Comment posting flow with @-mention works. No blocking bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py file is 1899 lines — consider splitting by router module (rounds, users, admin, courses) into separate files for maintainability. Not blocking.
MentionText.tsx: silent catch on tap failure is intentional/documented; acceptable UX.
Regex /(@[A-Za-z0-9_]+)/g in MentionText matches greedily on trailing underscores — fine for the current input format (MentionInput inserts trailing space).
seed_data_creation: Test round created and cleaned up inside test_log_round_and_achievements; no persistent artefacts left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GET /api/users/by-name/{display_name} resolves display names case-insensitively, treating underscores as spaces. Returns {id, display_name, avatar?}. MentionText component in /app/frontend/src/components/MentionText.tsx is wired into RoundCard, post/[id].tsx notes, and CommentRow.
